newsitem.title: USA: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA rice export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Sales of 124,100 MT, the highest so far in the marketing-year, were 30 percent above the week earlier and 78 percent over the 4-week average. Costa Rica (46,000 MT--all rough) dominated the week's activity, with smaller sales to Turkey (18,900 MT, all rough), Mexico (15,100 MT, of which 14,500 MT was rough), Japan (10,000 MT), Trinidad (5,000 MT), and Bulgaria (4,100 MT).

Exports of 63,100 MT were two and three-fifths times the prior week and 57 percent over the 4-week average. The major destinations were Turkey (16,900 MT), South Africa (8,600 MT), Mexico (7,500 MT), Ghana (7,100 MT), Haiti (5,300 MT), and Jamaica (5,300 MT).
